categories.title: Number and simple math
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We count and add in English: one, two, three … twenty, and plus, minus.

categories.title: Colors
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn color names: red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple, pink, brown, black, white, grey.

categories.title: Animals
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn animal names and what they do: cat, dog, bird, fish, frog, giraffe, elephant …

categories.title: Fruits and vegetables
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn fruit and vegetable names: apple, banana, mango, carrot, tomato, potato, corn …

categories.title: Body parts
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn body parts: head, hair, eye, ear, nose, mouth, teeth, hand, finger, arm, leg, foot.

categories.title: School objects
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn school things: book, pencil, pen, eraser, ruler, bag, chair, table, board, scissors, crayon.

categories.title: Food and drink
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn food and drink: rice, bread, egg, milk, water, juice, tea, cake, soup, noodles.

categories.title: Family members
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We learn family words: father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin.
tips: My father's brother is my uncle.
My mother's sister is my aunt.

categories.title: Daily activities and habits
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We talk about daily routines: wake up, take a bath, brush my teeth, have breakfast, go to school, sleep.
tips: I brush my teeth twice a day.

categories.title: Introducing oneself and others
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We introduce ourselves: "Hello, my name is …", "I am … years old", "This is my friend …".

categories.title: Simple descriptions
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We describe things and people: big, small, tall, short, long, happy, sad, hot, cold, fast, slow.

categories.title: Basic grammar and expressions
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: We use am/is/are, a/an, this/that, plurals, and polite expressions: please, thank you, sorry, excuse me.
tips: I am, you are, he is.
Say "thank you" when someone helps you.

categories.title: Mock Test KMSI English Kelas 1–2
categories.group: KMSI · Kompetensi Matematika Sains dan Bahasa Inggris — Penyisihan 2026
categories.intro: Tiga mock test seperti penyisihan KMSI Level 1: masing-masing 30 soal pilihan ganda English dari semua materi KMSI, mudah sampai sulit. Benar 4 poin, salah dan kosong 0. Lolos bila poin minimal 72 (KKM). Mock test 1 gratis satu kali; Mock test 2 dan 3 serta mengulang khusus Premium.
tips: Kerjakan yang yakin dulu; soal yang ragu boleh dilewati.
Salah tidak dikurangi, jadi usahakan menjawab semua soal.
